description: This file defines the NavigationViewHolder class, which is a RecyclerView.ViewHolder implementation used for displaying navigation items in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes. It manages binding data to views, handling click events, and applying branding styles.

classes.name: NavigationViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass that manages the display and interaction of navigation items in the Android client of Nextcloud Notes.

methods.name: NavigationViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view holder, binds views, and sets click listeners.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a NavigationItem to the view, updates UI elements, applies branding styles, and manages selection state.
